about_the_game:
Break Down Language Barriers: The Only Solution for Work, Entertainment, and Gaming!

Whether you're reading a foreign news site, communicating with an international colleague, or trying to communicate with your team in an online game, Quick Translate Engine breaks down language barriers.

No more getting lost between windows or trying to figure out complicated menus. With a single click, instantly translate any text on your screen and never lose focus.

About This App

Quick Translate Engine is a universal translation tool designed to help you overcome all language barriers you encounter in the digital world. This app enhances your productivity in both your professional and educational life while enriching your entertainment experience with features specifically designed for gamers.

With powerful OCR (Optical Character Recognition) technology and fully customizable shortcuts, the world's languages are at your fingertips. With its lightweight design and performance-friendly architecture, Quick Translate Engine runs quietly in the system tray and is ready to go whenever you need it.

Features

🚀 Instant Text Translation: Perfect for Chats and Messages

Translate text in emails, web pages, or any program instantly.

For gamers: This feature is a game-changer in online games! Communicate seamlessly with players from around the world. Read your teammate's message in your own language in seconds and respond to them in their language with a single shortcut. Language is no longer an obstacle to building the perfect team!

📸 Powerful Screen & OCR Translation: Understand Everything You See

Need to translate text from images, locked PDFs, or videos without subtitles? Select an area on the screen and let the app handle the rest.

For gamers: This opens the door to games you’ve always wanted to play but couldn’t because of the language barrier. Learn the immersive story of a JRPG, the properties of an item, or the details of a quest—all without leaving the game, thanks to instant translation.

💬 Immersive Bubble Translation: Never Lose Focus

Don’t disrupt your workflow or the game’s atmosphere! This innovative feature displays the translation directly over the original text in a sleek, semi-transparent bubble.

For gamers: This means a truly immersive experience. The translation becomes a natural part of your game world, allowing you to continue your adventure without distraction.

🧠 High-Quality Translation Engine

In addition to the fast and reliable MyMemory API, you can also use DeepL support for even higher-quality translations by adding a free API key. Get accurate translations in every context, from technical texts to slang-filled game chats.

⚙️ Efficient and Player-Friendly

Quick Translate Engine is optimized to use minimal system resources.

It won't slow down your computer while working or cause FPS drops while gaming. It runs quietly in the system tray, preserving both your efficiency and gaming enjoyment. (We recommend running your games in ‘Full-Screen Window’ mode for the best experience.)

Whether you're a globetrotting gamer, a multinational professional, or a curious student, Quick Translate Engine is the key to a connected world. Download it now and break down language barriers!

Note: This app requires an active internet connection as it uses web APIs for translation services.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 1.0 GHz Processor or better
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Any graphics card with DirectX 10 support or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 900 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: An active internet connection is required for translation features.

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Instant translation power! Assign a shortcut, select any text, and translate. Scan the screen with OCR for uncopyable text. Eliminate language barriers in games, on the web, everywhere.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish, Korean
